created_prompt: I'm a content creator who focuses on making cooking videos. I have 1.2 million followers and my most viewed content is related to quick and healthy meals. I want to publish a cookbook, but I'm still unsure on wether I should go traditional or self-publish. I work four days a week and I don't have a lot of time nor a big budget to work with. I need you to give me a step by step three-year plan to fit all the things I need to manage for content creation, pros and cons of publishing my cookbook traditional or by myself (and how to schedule writing and designing it), and I need this within my time and budget.
